Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Stay connected and in control with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch, featuring a vivid 1.9-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, and advanced health tracking for everyday performance.

Key Features:
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for sharp, vibrant visuals
- Bluetooth calling for convenient hands-free communication
- 7-day battery life for extended use
- Heart-rate monitoring for real-time health insights
- Sleep tracking to help improve rest and recovery
- IP68 waterproof protection for active lifestyles
- Fitness activity tracking to monitor daily movement

Promotional Tagline:
Smart living. Strong performance. Every day.
